description: Packed-bed PFR (amcrax.reactor) with literature kinetics (amcrax.kinetics); NOT Aspen results
assumptions: bed properties: kum2026heatintegrated p. 5 Table 1 (eps_b, rho_cat, dp, Din); rho_bed = (1-eps_b)*rho_cat as in Kum Table 2; same bed used for Takahashi powders (assumption)
n_tubes = 40 parallel tubes of 0.126 m ID (assumption, keeps Ergun dP < 1 bar at Ru W99)
Takahashi kinetics measured at 1 atm on powders; 20 bar use is extrapolation (mole-fraction basis)
Takahashi: AmCraX equilibrium approach factor (1-Q/K) ON
Kum T-P fit range 623-723 K, 1-10 bar; 20 bar / 873 K is extrapolation; Keq basis amcrax_thermo
effectiveness factor 1, no radial gradients, no axial dispersion

ni_takahashi_microkinetic.label: Ni/MgO microkinetic (Takahashi & Fujitani 2016)

validity.note: fit 350-450 degC, X<20 %, 1 atm; validated 500-650 degC at 1 atm (Figs. 1, 3, 5)

ru_takahashi_microkinetic.label: Ru/MgO microkinetic (Takahashi & Fujitani 2016)

validity.note: fit 300-400 degC, X<20 %, 1 atm; validated 450-550 degC at 1 atm (Figs. 2, 4, 5)
